name: (missing) Vendetta & Ashe — cutting ties / Grand Mesa
note: Present in Midseason 5 video; not found in theater after audit

lines.text: How unfortunate things ended up this way. All these bad headlines are rather inconvenient
How terrible for you
Oh don't fret, darling, it's nothing Vishkar won't recover from
Your reputation is the least of my concerns, Vaira
You may not have accomplished all that I desired, but what you did deliver shows great potential.
Potential? I handed you carnage in a pretty package.
It takes more than a honed edge to earn my praise. A weapon must prove itself in battle.
Are you satisfied, Akande? Reclaiming Talon just to hide away and atrophy once more?
On the contrary. Your crusade has proven that Talon's worth does not lie in its idleness
Ooh, must sting, yeah Schemin' like mad and still floppin'. (laughs)
Know that when you next fall prey to your own idiocy, I will celebrate your fall
Well, it was fun while it lasted. Come take over Talon again when you can
You mock me, Malosi. But we both know you will never be as entertained as you were when I was in charge
Easy, boss! I was being genuine
Good thing I ditched you... things ended up so messy, didn't they
All you did was hide. The Hashimoto were never strong enough to fight my battles
Hmm... well, neither were you
If you wish to goad me, do it on a battlefield. Then we will see who of us is stronger

name: Going away for a long time

lines.text: You're going away for a long time, Marzia. Long enough to realize your conquest was never an option
Don't waste your breath condemning me. When Akande sees fit to destroy you, you will wish I was there to oppose him
Pobre Vendetta! Guess your little Talon scheme didn't turn out how you planned, huh
Silence, Infame. I will rip out your throat
You can try. But those fangs of yours are looking a little dull these days
Well well... it seems your hunt has ended right where it began
And what of yours For all your 'newfound independence', you still rely on others to numb your pain
Whatever shame I feel, I take comfort in knowing your humiliation far exceeds it
You and your Big Omnic Buddy seem very close! I wish I had a friend like him growing up
Me and him have been through thick and thin, but I'll never trust him at cards. Can't beat that poker face
I used to believe there was nothing I would not do to save my colony... but what you did is out of the question!
Such naïveté is to be expected of a child. Life is not so fair as you believe
I cannot help thinking I have seen you somewhere before, Fika
**evasive meows**
But I had only travelled to a few places before Brigitte found you... and you were definitely not on Mars
**innocent meows**
I just love looking up at the stars once I hit a summit... I bet the view from Mars is something else!
Oh, it is! I always loved looking down at Earth from the top of Olympus Mons
Well, you'll just have to take a picture for me once we get you back up there
You've come so far since you landed, Juno--and seen so much of the world, too! Where to next
Thank you! Maybe I could visit the Arcology Or Spain Oh, I cannot decide!
Maybe Athena could help you pick! She's the world's best atlas, if you ask me
Juno, from one extraterrestrial to another... I'm proud of how far you've come. Overwatch is lucky to have you
Oh, Winston! I have only accomplished so much thanks to the guidance of my space-faring friend
(bashful chuckle) Well, as long as we keep working together, we'll both be out of this world!
Dr. Chao said she would have made a different decision about Project Red Promise if only she had known. But is that really true?
**hamster noises** He says, they do have a habit of abandoning projects
Juno, I was thinking we could do more combat training simulations T-together
Excellent idea! Sierra invited me just the other day. I will tell her you are joining us!
Oh, I was thinking-- I mean I was hoping it would just be... I-I mean, that sounds great!
So, Juno, how did you like your first post-mission pierogis
Oh, they were delicious! And just as Auntie Mei said... like dumplings, but with potato!
Excellent! Then we will have many more. With kolbasas, for extra protein
I've apprehended plenty of criminals, but it isn't often their own family turns them in
My brother's reaction was hyperbolically rash... but he must know I have only acted in the name of his good health.
My brother's outburst was a rash mistake... but he must know I did what was best for him
I'd say you'll realize you can't decide for others someday, but you've had more time than even I have to learn that lesson.
Has your proficiency waned over time? I imagine it must have, given your inevitable decrepitude
Your own age is getting to you, if you need a reminder of my skill
My clarity of mind greatly surpasses that of the average elder!
(sighs) You are not as special as you think
You ever try performing? I bet you'd rock a stage!
Funny you say that. I had to pose as a lounge singer for six years on an undercover mission in Beirut
Really?
No.
When I heard you left Talon after Vendetta's coup, I thought you had finally come to your senses
Sorry to disappoint
Don't be. It's my own fault, holding onto hope you might change
I've been working with the daughter of an enhanced soldier, Gabriel... She's as gifted as her mother
Hmph. Didn't think they let anyone use the serum anymore
They don't, yet she still shows all the signs. Doesn't that concern you?
It didn't... until now
We spent years throwing Doctrine and his like into Grímsvötn. And now you've just let them all out?
You locked them up once. Just do it again
You and Fareeha made a good team in Lagos. I can tell she's happy to have another Helix operative at her side
Aw, well I just love working with her too! Those Raptora suits really are something
MEKA owes you for having our backs, Sojourn. Ping me if there's ever anything we can do for you
I will. But after your help in Rome, I'd say we can call it even
It doesn't undo anything you've done... but it's not lost on me that you saved my life back in Rome
Even at my most arrogant, my respect for you was never in question
Guessing I can't convince you to stand down? Let the world recover from Vendetta's war in peace?
You know as well as I do that peace breeds complacency. And complacency, vulnerability
(sigh) Well, I had to ask. We'll just have to do things the hard way
You had Doomfist in your sights, and you let him walk free
I had to make a choice, Orisa. With the state we were in, we wouldn't have survived that fight
There are things more important than survival. Bringing him to justice is one of them
Efi and I looked up to you, Sojourn. Doomfist deserves to be punished for what he did to our city--our family!
Real life isn't as simple as the cartoons, Orisa... as much as I wish it was
Hey, Commander... Now that Vendetta's done for, would it be all right if I took some shore leave
Yeah What for
Well... it's Emily. There's something I've really been wanting to ask her
(chuckle) As long as I get an invite when the time comes... permission granted
I wanted to think there was a good reason I saw you with Talon, but after everything Vendetta's done It's inexcusable
Whatever you think of me, Viv, I promise I've thought worse
I know. I don't expect forgiveness these days
Next chance I get to bash your mech, screws'll be shooting out like candy from a piñata!
Makes sense. You would know a thing or two about having a screw loose
I'll admit, I was worried you wouldn't believe me when I said the mech you captured housed an intelligent hamster
If anyone other than a literal space ape had told me, I probably wouldn't have
(chuckle) I suppose that does give me a bit of credibility
We went easy on you before, but mess with Busan again and I'll shut you down
**hamster noises** He will take you seriously once you defeat your robot squids
I was right to seek you out. This gauntlet you've crafted surpasses my every expectation
Ah, one can accomplish much when the wisdom of age comes without cost
Be grateful I was not there to greet you in Rome. You would not have left alive
The child has made you strong, Orisa. May she give you the wisdom to understand your leader's choices, next
So when were you planning to tell me your ace in the hole is a geriatric soul-sapper
Tell you I thought uncovering information was your expertise
I can't hack your brain, jefe
Then you still have room to improve
So glad you're finally back home! Just don't go forgetting your old crew, all right
Please, Lena. No matter where I go, I will never forget our team
(sniffle) Good. 'Cause you better believe I'm flying everyone out to visit next time we get shore leave!
I'm glad to see you reunite with your family after so long, Genji
As am I. Perhaps you can do the same, one day
Oh, I don't know… I'm not even sure if Hammond still sees me as family
Believe me even deep wounds can be mended with time
The rift between Hanzo and I is slowly healing. But with others, his unforgiving nature rears its head
What he does not forgive in others reflects what he does not accept of himself
Maybe I oughtta take my ship up to where you and the champ lived. See how Gracie likes zero-grav
Ah, the Lunar Colony would not be easily accessible without... significant upgrades to your craft
Well that's what the champ's for. He'll figure it out
Busan was nice
Well, it would be nicer if certain tourists didn't leave their junk all over the city!
Sorry.
That EMP was designed to free Busan from the Gwishin. Nothing you've done could take that hope from our people
You have wasted your arsenal on defensive maneuvers. In my hands, the world will know its true strength
Celebrate, then! It is back in your care, and you may return to cowering behind its power while the Gwishin assau
Lovin' the bleached look. You do that yourself?
Sweet of you to say so, darlin', but it's natural.
Goodness! No. I was just born this dashing.
Of course! It's aged to perfection!
Ah. You like it. Gets grayer every time I hear about your escapades.
Right, well... looks class!
(soft chuckle) No, this comes with experience
Give it a few years, kid, and you won't have to ask
(snort) Thanks. Yeah
